title: Alaskaweg, Hamburg
description:
Sunny Apartment with garden view. The studio apartment has been completely renovated recently, including furniture. The separate kitchen is completely equipped, including dish washer. The sleeping area has a 1,40m x 200m double bed and is separated by a sideboard from the living and working area. Living area comprises a three seat sofa with chaiselong, table and flat TV. Working area has a table (prolongable) and two chairs and storage space. 

A spacious balcony gives a nice view into the garden, no opposite buildings. 

Shops and public transport in 250m. Tubstation Berne is 600m. Completely calm. 

Private Parking is available for 40€ extra per month.

title: Lottbeker Weg, Hamburg
description:
Arrive, unpack, feel at home – that's all it takes. This fully furnished 4-room apartment with 135 sqm is ready and waiting for you in the leafy north of Hamburg.
The spacious living room with a comfortable sofa arrangement is your spot to unwind. Two individually furnished bedrooms provide plenty of privacy, while a separate study offers space for remote work, creative projects, or simply some quiet time. The kitchen comes fully equipped with a stove, oven, fridge, dishwasher, and everything you need in terms of dishes and cookware for everyday life. Step out onto the balcony and you'll immediately see why Bergstedt is so popular with families and nature lovers – greenery all around.
All utilities are included in the rent – Wi-Fi, electricity, heating, and water. One price, nothing extra.
The location offers the best of both worlds: the Alstertal Nature Park with its walking and hiking trails is right on your doorstep, while supermarkets, cafés, and restaurants are just a short walk away. The Buckhorn underground station (U1 line) takes you to Hamburg city center in around half an hour.
Ideal for anyone starting fresh in Hamburg, spending a few months in the city for work, or simply looking for a temporary home with real living comfort.

title: Lottbeker Weg, Hamburg
description:
No stress, no setup – just move in and start living. This completely equipped 4-room apartment welcomes you in one of Hamburg's most peaceful northern neighborhoods, surrounded by nature.
A bright, generous living area with a cozy seating setup gives you the perfect place to relax after a long day. The two separate bedrooms are each thoughtfully furnished, giving everyone their own space. There's also a dedicated room that works beautifully as a home office, reading nook, or hobby room – however you need it. In the kitchen, everything is already there: cooktop, oven, refrigerator, dishwasher, plus a full set of pots, pans, plates, and utensils. You won't need to buy a thing. A private balcony lets you soak in the greenery that makes this neighborhood so special.
Forget about extra bills – Wi-Fi, power, heat, and water are all covered in the monthly rent. Simple and transparent.
Bergstedt strikes a rare balance: you're steps away from the Alstertal Nature Park with its scenic trails along the river, yet daily essentials like grocery stores, bakeries, and dining options are all within easy reach. Hop on the U1 at Buckhorn station and you'll be in downtown Hamburg in roughly 30 minutes.
Whether you're relocating for a new job, on a longer project assignment, or between permanent homes – this is a place where you can truly settle in from day one.

title: Kathenkoppel, Hamburg
description:
The beautiful 78 sqm apartment with a terrace is located on the ground floor of a small and well-maintained residential complex in Berne.

The apartment was extensively renovated and furnished to a high standard in 2024 and will be available again from the start of August.

It features a spacious hallway, a bathroom with a walk-in shower, a designer kitchen, a bedroom with a queen-size bed, and a large 35 sqm living room with access to the terrace. The living room can be separated by a curtain and used as a guest room (sofa bed).

For laundry, there is a communal washing and drying room in the basement, which can be used by all residents (coin-operated machines).

Various shopping options and a small park with a beautiful lake are located nearby. The Oldenfelde subway station is just a few minutes’ walk away, providing a connection to the city center in approximately 22 minutes.
